title: Sheehan represented John Mack and vetted experiencers

tellings.quote: well I I represented him for 10 years uh and uh met dozens of people uh that he had worked with

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says he was the legal representative for the Harvard psychiatrist John Mack for about ten years, starting around 1990. Mack worked with "experiencers," people who say they have had contact with alien beings. Sheehan tells Michels that during those years he met dozens of the people Mack had worked with, which means he saw the people behind Mack's cases for himself.
